2023-4518-4885-6723.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

803-1315-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-1315-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-1322-6495.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5526-5702-7824.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
5526-5702-7824.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl's Will
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

7600-7811.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
7600-7811.description:
Draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Generous Patron's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

4186-6824-6890-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-6824-6890-7810.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

1274-1379-2685-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1379-2685-4186.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2796-5638.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Equipment.
2796-5638.description:
Activate Plate Armor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Aristocrat.
Cephalid Aristocrat triggers, causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve Plate Armor's ability, attaching it to Cephalid Aristrocrat.
Repeat.

222-527-1322-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1322-6798.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

413-2523-5558.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Enraged Huorn.
When Enraged Huorn dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Enraged Huorn that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Enraged Huorn token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Enraged Huorn trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Enraged Huorn token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

643-997-3951-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
643-997-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

225-565-1987-3277.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-565-1987-3277.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing land.
Orvar triggers, creating a copy of the mana-producing land.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
Holding priority, activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking the land and Izzet Chronarch.
When the land and Izzet Chronarch enter the battlefield, Izzet Chronarch and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 8, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
225-565-1987-3277.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Ghostly Flicker targeting any other permanent(s).

2034-2308-2612-6191.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Mirkwood Bats triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Mirkwood Bats triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.
Resolve all remaining Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain that much life, choosing not to pay for the Trudge Garden triggers in between.

1365-1379-2511-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1379-2511-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

647-3259-3263-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
647-3259-3263-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-3263-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4068-5359.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-5359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1770-4813-5003-5256.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
1770-4813-5003-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Famished Foragers.
When Famished Foragers dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Famished Foragers from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Famished Foragers' power.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Famished Foragers' ability to infinitely rummage.

511-2060-3008-3048.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Sporoloth Ancient has at least one spore counter on it.
511-2060-3008-3048.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient and two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1678-2211-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure token.
Captain's Hook attached to Mayhem Devil.
1678-2211-4508.description:
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Mayhem Devil triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

147-1370-1379-5256.description:
Cast Brilliant Restoration by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
In response, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Brilliant Restoration.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing any player to mill two cards.
Resolve a copy of Brilliant Restoration, returning all nonland permanent cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1912-3706-4474-5153.notablePrerequisites:
Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sunstrike Legionnaire.
1912-3706-4474-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {G}.
Pay {G} to create a 2/2 Wolf token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

1648-2034-2499-2781.notablePrerequisites:
Nissa has at least 6 loyalty counters.
You control at least four lands.
1648-2034-2499-2781.description:
Activate Nissa's -5 to put Felidar Guardian onto the battlefield from the graveyard.
Using its ETB blink Nissa and a land.
Nissa and the land both enter putting 2 loyalty counters on Nissa.
Sacrifice Felidar Guardian to Ashnod's Altar for {2}.
Repeat.
